3a1f399c-c718-41b2-b540-545a119db6ad.observation: Attributes a rising Mali death toll to unnamed local and security sources; the estimate remains provisional.

3a1f399c-c718-41b2-b540-545a119db6ad.title: 11 soldiers killed in explosion at military site in east Syria
3a1f399c-c718-41b2-b540-545a119db6ad.observation: Identifies Syrian official accounts and explicitly says the weapons-depot explosion’s cause remains under investigation.

3a1f399c-c718-41b2-b540-545a119db6ad.title: EU urges US to reconsider visa denial to Palestinian delegation
3a1f399c-c718-41b2-b540-545a119db6ad.observation: Attributes the visa objection to an EU statement and distinguishes a UN remote-address vote from visa approval.

faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.title: The U.S. Is Highly Vulnerable to Cyber Threats From China. Here’s What It Should Do
faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.observation: Links Justice Department actions and a CFR study group; proposed cyber-defense reforms are policy recommendations.

faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.title: The U.S.-China AI Race is Changing the Stakes for Taiwan
faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.observation: Links company supply-chain disclosures and reporting; predicted Taiwan-related strategic incentives remain interpretation.

faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.title: How the U.S. Can Alter Putin’s Calculus on Ukraine
faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.observation: Combines Russian financial data with news reports; a proposed strategy for changing Putin’s decisions is an argument, not a demonstrated outcome.

faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.title: Is the U.S. Army Backing Off on Drones?
faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.observation: Credits Wall Street Journal exercise reporting and an Army statement; the author discloses prior Defense Department service.

faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.title: On the Ground in Haiti: The Growing War Zone Facing U.S. Deportees
faa96f08-002a-49fc-9504-0533e9337e88.observation: Describes the author’s Haiti visit and links government testimony and humanitarian context; population-wide figures are distinct from firsthand observations.

c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.title: September: the longer view
c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.observation: Not reported content at all: the entry carries no dc:creator byline and its description is a one-line pointer to the month's archives plus directory and tag links, so there is no claim, source or attribution in it to assess.

c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.title: UK sanctions: Israel can rest easy
c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.observation: The excerpt anchors itself to a datable on-record event — a 8 September statement to the House of Commons as part of a twelve-country initiative — and attributes both the ethnic-cleansing characterisation and the description of which companies and individuals the measures target to the named UK foreign secretary rather than asserting them in the magazine's voice; the excerpt carries no author byline and breaks off mid-sentence before any Israeli or government response appears.

c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.title: Somaliland in the Great Game
c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.observation: Bylined to Brendon Novel, the excerpt states in the magazine's own voice that Somaliland is now an ally of Israel and holds commercial and security agreements in the Gulf without naming the agreements, dates or any official confirming them, while keeping the US element correctly in the conditional as something Somaliland is hoping for rather than a concluded arrangement.

c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.title: The search for an alternative to the dollar is on
c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.observation: Bylined to three named authors (Renaud Lambert, Frederic Lemaire and Julien Trevisan); the excerpt offers one checkable factual anchor — recent US support for the yen — and builds the rest as the authors' own analysis, with the closing claim that replacing the dollar carries its own risks being a forecast rather than a reported event.

c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.title: Donald Trump's red scare
c9705158-d51e-441b-ad76-2750b7cb643c.observation: Bylined to Serge Halimi and tagged as an article rather than an editorial, the excerpt asserts that Trump's ratings are falling without citing any poll or pollster, and characterises his revival of the communist spectre and framing of the left as a terrorist threat as the writer's own reading of his conduct rather than quoting specific statements.

26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.title: Chinese mainland punishes Taiwan company related to die-hard separatist
26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.observation: A Xinhua reprint (BEIJING dateline, closing "Source: Xinhua" line) in which the sanction on Sicuens International is attributed to a named official, Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhu Fenglian, and carries her direct quote, while the headline's "die-hard separatist" label for Shen Pao-yang sits in the outlet's own voice outside any attributed quote; neither the company nor Shen is quoted in reply, and the earlier claims about the Kuma Academy are attributed to "the office said" rather than to evidence.

26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.title: Mainland spokesperson slams Taiwan leader's defamatory remarks
26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.observation: A single-source Xinhua reprint built entirely on Zhu Fenglian's answer to an unspecified "media query": the charged language ("extremely sinister", "fake democracy, real dictatorship") is quoted and attributed to her by name, but the Lai Ching-te and DPP remarks being answered are characterised as "defaming" and "defamatory" in the outlet's headline and text without being quoted, dated or linked, so the rebuttal runs without the statement it rebuts.

26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.title: China unveils new regulations on government data sharing
26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.observation: Sourced to one official instrument — a State Council decree signed by Premier Li Qiang — with the provisions consistently hedged back to it ("according to the document", "says the document") rather than asserted by the outlet; the Aug. 1 effective date is presented as a scheduled future step, not an implemented change, and the decree is described but never named or linked, so a reader cannot check the text against the summary.

26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.title: Xi's article on building China into leading country in education to be published
26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.observation: Reports a forthcoming publication rather than an event: it summarises an article by Xi Jinping ahead of its appearance in the 11th issue of Qiushi Journal, attributing every substantive claim to the unreleased article itself ("the article emphasizes", "urged", "calls for") with no byline and no source beyond the Xinhua dateline, so readers get a state-wire précis of a document they could not yet read at publication time.

26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.title: China appoints new director for liaison office of central gov't in HKSAR
26757646-7dd9-469e-9c6c-1c0a51ebdf1e.observation: A 638-character personnel notice resting on a single authority — "China's State Council announced on Friday" — under which both Zhou Ji's appointment and Zheng Yanxiong's removal from three posts are stated as accomplished fact; no reason for the removal is given, no effective date is stated, and no second party is consulted, making it a transcription of an official announcement rather than reporting around it.

95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.title: 欧洲央行宣布下调欧元区关键利率
95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.observation: A two-sentence Xinhua newsflash (新华社快讯) carried without a byline: the 25-basis-point cut to the euro area's three key rates is attributed to the European Central Bank's own announcement of 5 June, while the framing of it as the eighth cut in a year is stated in the wire's voice, and no ECB official or outside analyst is quoted in the excerpt.

95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.title: 美联储“褐皮书”：美国经济不确定性居高位　关税推高物价
95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.observation: Xinhua copy datelined New York, 4 June, bylined reporter Liu Yanan; every substantive claim about US activity, hiring and prices is tied back to the Federal Reserve's Beige Book itself through repeated "报告显示" / "报告说" attribution, the excerpt explains that the document is compiled from the twelve reserve banks' surveys, and no Fed official, business or independent economist is quoted alongside it.

95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.title: 商务部：中方对合规稀土出口许可申请将予以批准
95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.observation: Xinhua copy datelined Beijing, 5 June, bylined Xie Xiyao, consisting entirely of remarks by a named Ministry of Commerce spokesperson, He Yongqian, answering a question at a regular press briefing; the characterisation of rare-earth export controls as "international practice" is carried as her statement rather than asserted by the outlet, and the excerpt contains no response from licence applicants or foreign governments.

95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.title: 外交部：中国愿继续与各方一道推动共建清洁、美丽、可持续的世界
95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.observation: Xinhua copy datelined Beijing, 5 June, bylined Yuan Rui, which reproduces the reporter's question at the Foreign Ministry briefing and then attributes the rest to named spokesperson Lin Jian, including the quantitative claims — over 80% of the world's solar modules, 70% of wind equipment, a quarter of new green area — which appear as the spokesperson's figures with no dataset, agency or third party cited for them.

95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.title: 来自神舟二十号的“太空问候”！中国航天员为世博会中国馆送祝福
95367176-3529-4a43-8480-2642f4044909.observation: Original People's Daily Online reporting rather than a Xinhua reprint, datelined Tokyo, 5 June, bylined Xu Ke, sourced to video messages from Shenzhou-20 astronauts Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie whose remarks are paraphrased in indirect speech rather than quoted verbatim; the surrounding description of the Osaka Expo China pavilion attracting "countless visitors" is asserted by the outlet with no attendance figure or source attached.

fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.title: ‘No restraint’ against any aggression: Iran's top military command warns US, its regional allies
fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.observation: The warning is attributed to an institution rather than a person — Iran's joint operational military command — with no named spokesperson, statement number or broadcast cited; the word "painful" is carried in quotation marks as the command's own characterization, and the retaliation described is a conditional future threat, not a reported event.

fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.title: Qalibaf: No reopening of Hormuz until US meets Iran’s conditions
fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.observation: The claim is attributed to a single named speaker by surname only (Qalibaf), with no office, venue or date for the remarks given in the excerpt; the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and the existence of an ongoing war are carried as unattributed background, while only the condition for reopening is marked as his statement.

fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.title: Iran’s president to attend UN General Assembly in New York
fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.observation: A scheduled future event stated flatly in the outlet's own voice — Pezeshkian addressing the 81st UNGA session on Wednesday — with no attribution to a foreign ministry announcement, presidential office statement or UN speakers list, so the excerpt gives the reader no way to check where the itinerary came from.

fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.title: Iranian lawmakers push for NPT withdrawal, submit bill to Parliament's Presiding Board
fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.observation: Attribution is to an unnamed collective ("Iranian lawmakers") with no sponsor named, no signature count and no text of the NPT-withdrawal bill quoted; the headline asserts a specific procedural step — submission to Parliament's Presiding Board — that the excerpt itself does not source or repeat.

fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.title: Stories Beyond Numbers: Mojtaba, three-day-old infant whose life was cut short before it could bloom
fddb6a9c-1379-456f-8b95-6396ed1c3e08.observation: A commemorative feature whose factual anchor is a named artist's painting (Parisa Rashidi) rather than a casualty record, hospital source or investigation; responsibility for the infant's death is assigned in the outlet's own voice by the framing "the US-Israeli war on Iran" and by the URL slug's "US-Israeli strike", with no official finding or named witness cited in the excerpt.

14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Storming of Al-Aqsa Mosque Courtyards by Israeli Occupation Official, Settlers
14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.observation: The condemnation is attributed to "Saudi Arabia" as an unnamed collective actor with no ministry, spokesperson or statement document identified, and the judgments "flagrant violation" and "provocation to Muslims worldwide" are carried as Riyadh's characterisation rather than asserted by QNA, though the underlying entry into the Al-Aqsa courtyards is stated as fact and the actor is labelled "Israeli occupation official" in the agency's own voice with no Israeli response in the excerpt.

14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.title: Palestinian Awqaf Condemns Storming of Al-Aqsa Mosque by Extremist Israeli Minister
14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.observation: This item names the individual, Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, and attributes the account of the visit and the "Talmudic rituals" to the Jerusalem Governorate, but the verb "strutted" and the headline's "extremist" are QNA's own characterisation rather than the cited source's, and no Israeli or police account is included in the excerpt.

14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.title: Arab League Condemns Ongoing Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.observation: The condemnation is attributed to a named institution, the General Secretariat of the Arab League, but the factual claims inside it — a ballistic missile launched toward Riyadh and attempts on several Saudi cities — reach the reader only through that condemnation, with no separate Saudi military confirmation or Houthi claim of responsibility cited in the excerpt.

14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.title: North Korea Fires Two Missiles Toward the Sea of Japan
14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.observation: The launch itself is asserted flatly with no detecting authority named in the excerpt — no South Korean Joint Chiefs, Japanese ministry or US command is credited for the two-missile count or trajectory — while the secondary claim that the US is stoking tensions through military drills is properly attributed to Pyongyang rather than stated as fact.

14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.title: 6.1-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Papua New Guinea
14a5243f-c665-461f-9f73-d0ee042250e9.observation: A single named technical source, the German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ), carries the magnitude figure, and the excerpt confines itself to that measured event without asserting casualties, damage or a tsunami risk that would need separate sourcing.

e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.title: Israeli enemy Raid Biddu Town, Northwest of Al-Quds
e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.observation: The raid on Biddu and the encirclement of a mosque are asserted in the agency's own voice with no witness, official, military statement or partner agency credited anywhere in the excerpt, and the actor is identified by the label "Israeli enemy" rather than by a neutral noun; no Israeli account of the incident appears.

e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.title: Liverpool Returns to Winning Ways with Hard-Fought Victory over Bournemouth in Premier League
e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.observation: A completed and publicly verifiable event — the 1-0 scoreline, Matchweek 5, and Alexander Isak as scorer — reported as unattributed fact with no named reporter, wire service or club source, which is the usual form for a short sports result but leaves no way to trace whether this is original reporting or a reprint.

e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.title: 6.1-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Papua New Guinea
e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.observation: The 6.1 magnitude figure is stated flatly without naming the seismological body that measured it (no USGS, EMSC or national agency is credited in the excerpt); the item confines itself to the occurrence and makes no casualty, damage or depth claims it would need to source.

e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.title: Iranian Parliament Mandates Use of "Persian Gulf" in Treaties and Negotiations
e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.observation: The action is attributed to a specific named institution — the National Security and Foreign Policy Committee of the Iranian Parliament (Majlis) — but the excerpt names no spokesperson, Iranian outlet or document it is drawn from, and describes a committee mandate rather than an enacted law, a distinction the headline verb "Mandates" does not preserve.

e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.title: Israeli forces raid Beit Duqqu, besiege Mosque
e2ef9326-4382-4c60-80b7-03599b832d70.observation: The excerpt marks one claim as unproven — Qadri Samara is called an "alleged shooting suspect" — while naming him in full, yet states the raid, the siege of Abdullah bin Jaber Mosque and the presence of worshippers at afternoon prayers as established fact with no witness, resident or official cited; this item uses "Israeli forces" where the sibling item from the same hour uses "Israeli enemy".

ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.title: Syrian Foreign Minister receives outgoing Omani ambassador
ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.observation: A ministry-meeting readout that cites no source at all: both named officials (al-Shaibani and Ambassador al-Busaidi) appear only as participants, and the account of what the minister expressed is written in SANA's own voice with no statement, spokesperson or ministry release cited.

ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.title: Israeli occupation forces carry out new incursion into western Daraa countryside
ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.observation: The operational detail (two tanks and a military vehicle, fire opened, no casualties) is attributed to a single in-house source, "SANA's reporter in Daraa," with no Israeli military response sought or noted, while the closing paragraphs assert as established fact that Israel has continued violating the 1974 Disengagement Agreement and use the characterisation "occupation forces" unattributed in the outlet's own voice.

ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.title: Syria, South Korea sign education grant, media cooperation agreements
ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.observation: A documented event rather than a claim: all four signatories are named (Qutaiba Qadish and Ambassador Geon Gyusuk; Alaa Barsilo and Arirang/KIBF), but the agreements' terms, including the right to broadcast three dubbed Korean programmes, are summarised without citing the texts or a ministry statement, and the closing December 2025 economic-forum background carries no source.

ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.title: Regional leaders discuss security, cooperation amid Middle East tensions
ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.observation: Openly an aggregation of other agencies' official readouts, each strand separately sourced — WAM for the UAE-Greece call, KUNA for the Kuwait-Egypt call, the Saudi Foreign Ministry for the Faisal bin Farhan-Safadi talks and Jordan's army for the drone shoot-down — so the condemnation of "Iranian attacks" is carried as the two ministers' statement rather than asserted by SANA, and the drone claim rests on the Jordanian military's account with no independent confirmation.

ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.title: Syria, Egypt discuss expanding economic ties, reviving joint business council
ea8f2e46-714b-4ba7-9e05-f0d35c59000c.observation: Sourced explicitly and repeatedly to one party's readout ("the ministry said," "The Ministry of Economy and Industry said"), with both participants named (Nidal Al-Shaar, Chargé d'Affaires Mohamed el-Feki) and no Egyptian-side account; the forward-looking elements — reactivating the business council and a proposed Aleppo industrial zone — are framed as discussion and proposal rather than as concluded agreements.

64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.title: Covert Pentagon propagandists are tracking anti-war Americans, skirting the law
64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.observation: Bylined to Wyatt Reed, the excerpt anchors its central claim in a named self-identification — a conservative activist posting as "Datarepublican" who it says "quietly admitted she was employed by the Pentagon as a 'special government employee'" — while the legal conclusion is hedged to the outlet's own inference ("the Pentagon appears to be breaking the law") rather than attributed to a court, inspector general or Pentagon statement; no Pentagon response appears in the excerpt.

64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.title: Charlie Kirk’s TPUSA sponsored by Israeli govt-aligned outfit, leaked contract shows
64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.observation: Bylined to Max Blumenthal, the item sources its headline claim to a document the outlet holds rather than to a third party ("leaked contract shows", "The Grayzone can reveal"), and separately states as established record that the show is "distributed by a federally registered agent of Israel" — a FARA-type registration the excerpt does not cite by filing; no comment from TPUSA or the International Fellowship of Christians and Jews appears in the excerpt.

64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.title: As criticism grows over landslide inaction, leaks show Nepal’s new leaders groomed by US regime change outfit
64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.observation: Bylined to Kit Klarenberg, this is the only one of the five whose excerpt points readers to its underlying primary material ("See the complete files here"), and it hedges the causal link between the leaked NED-related files and the new government ("came to power thanks in part to"), while the landslide toll of "over 1,000 lives" is asserted without attribution to any Nepalese authority or agency.

64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.title: Trump lifts sanctions on top Al Qaeda recruiters, financiers days before 9/11 anniversary
64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.observation: Bylined to Max Blumenthal, the excerpt rests on a checkable administrative act — removal of named individuals from the US designated-terrorist list — but the characterisation of delistee Abdullah Muhaysini as having "recruited child fighters and teen suicide bombers" is asserted in the outlet's own voice with no document, official or prior finding cited in the excerpt, and the 9/11-anniversary timing is presented as juxtaposition rather than as a stated motive.

64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.title: ADC files federal lawsuit against DHS and CBP over unconstitutional targeting of Max Blumenthal
64dc75a7-ba07-4e74-a233-92f18676f237.observation: Carries the institutional byline "The Grayzone" and concerns the outlet's own editor, so the publication is reporting on itself; the substantive claims are correctly framed as untested allegations in a filed complaint ("The lawsuit accuses the government of…") rather than as findings, and the Laura Loomer element is attributed to her own public boasts with the causal question left open ("Was federal law enforcement…").

86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.title: UN: Iran using drones to enforce hijab law
86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.observation: The headline attributes the drone-surveillance claim to "UN" as an unnamed collective, and the feed's entire excerpt is one truncated fragment ("Other tools include facial recognition, app") that names no UN body, report or official, so at feed level the sourcing is a bare institutional label; the author field is the generic desk credit "VOA News" rather than a named reporter.

86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.title: VOA Kurdish: Senior ISIS leader killed in Iraqi intelligence operation
86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.observation: The killing is attributed on the record to an announcement by Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shia Sudani, but the follow-on characterisations of Abu Khadija ("one of ISIS's most active leaders," "the driving force behind ISIS attacks on Iraqi forces") are asserted in VOA's own voice with no source attached; the item is bylined Dilshad Anwar and is a pointer to the full Kurdish-service story rather than a standalone English report.

86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.title: VOA Kurdish: Release of man's confession sparks legal concerns
86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.observation: The underlying event -- a confession made public by Irbil security forces -- is stated as fact and attributed to those forces, while the broader claim that this is part of a pattern ("not the first time something like this has happened") is attributed to unnamed "human rights groups and lawyers," none identified in the excerpt; bylined Diyar Jamal, again as a pointer to the Kurdish-language original.

86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.title: VOA Kurdish: Syria's interim constitution raises fears of sectarian division
86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.observation: The signing of the interim constitution is reported as an event, but everything consequential in the excerpt is forecast rather than fact and is hedged to unnamed sources -- "experts warn" the provisions could seed a permanent constitution in five years, and "many fear" sectarian rule -- with no expert, institution or constitutional provision cited; bylined Balen Salih.

86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.title: VOA Kurdish: Kurds in Iran celebrate Nowruz despite threats from Iranian Guards
86b90414-8b86-4871-89f5-d3fd90f3e847.observation: Both halves of the claim -- the threats from Iranian security institutions and the celebrations proceeding anyway -- are sourced in the excerpt to "two Kurdish human rights groups," which are counted but not named, and the excerpt carries no Iranian official response or denial; bylined Ozlem Yasak.

07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.title: Trump’s ambassador to U.N. says there’s no timeline on Iran war’s end
07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.observation: Both the headline and the excerpt route every claim through a named official — U.N. ambassador Mike Waltz — using "said" framing, so the assertion that the naval blockade "was having the intended effect" on Iran's economy is presented as his characterisation rather than a verified finding, and the excerpt sets it against Tehran's own stated position that it is not backing down.

07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.title: Russia recruited Ukrainian children to carry out attacks. They were imprisoned.
07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.observation: The headline and excerpt state as established fact that at least 13 minors are imprisoned after being paid by Russia to attack their own country; at feed level no source is named for that figure — no court records, prosecutors or defence lawyers are cited in the excerpt — though the piece carries a single reporter byline (Serhiy Morgunov) rather than a wire credit.

07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.title: Houthis claim attacks on ‘sensitive sites’ in Saudi Arabian capital
07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.observation: The headline explicitly labels the attack as a Houthi claim and puts the group's phrase "sensitive sites" in quotation marks rather than adopting it, while the excerpt offers a separate observable detail — video footage of black smoke near Riyadh's international airport — without asserting that the claimed targets were actually struck.

07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.title: Can Mamdani-style populism win in Berlin? Mayoral race offers test for left.
07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.observation: The headline is posed as an open question about a future election rather than a finding, and the single concrete item in the excerpt is a checkable event — candidate Elif Eralp met with an adviser to New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani — while the "test for the left" comparison is the paper's own analytical frame, not attributed to any named source in the excerpt.

07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.title: In Russia, the election result is easy to guess. Much else there is uncertain.
07717837-005e-47ea-bf1a-714f6ed1397e.observation: The excerpt separates a reported event — Russians voting in parliamentary elections this weekend — from a forecast stated in the Post's own voice, that the outcome favouring United Russia is "assured"; that prediction carries no attribution to a pollster, analyst or official in the excerpt, and the item is bylined to two named reporters.

bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.title: Palestinians clash with Israeli soldiers after protest against Pence visit
bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.observation: The excerpt is a photo caption rather than a sourced news item: it describes the pictured action ("Palestinian protesters hurl stones at Israeli soldiers during clashes") as directly observed, fixed to a place and date (Hebron, West Bank, Jan. 23, 2018), so nothing is attributed to any official or witness because nothing beyond the frame is claimed; no photographer or agency credit appears in the feed excerpt.

bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.title: U.S. failure to appoint Australian ambassador "diplomatic insult": former deputy PM
bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.observation: Attribution is carried in the headline itself via the colon convention, assigning the "diplomatic insult" characterization to a named individual, former Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer, with the contested phrase kept inside quotation marks and the verb "has accused" in the excerpt, so the judgment is presented as his accusation rather than as the outlet's finding; the excerpt does not say where or to whom Fischer made the remark.

bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.title: Speaker of Hungarian Parliament addresses in Budapest
bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.observation: Another photo caption, which identifies its subject precisely by name, title and position in the frame (Laszlo Kover, 1st L, Speaker of the Hungarian Parliament) and names the occasion and date (a conference of Western Balkans parliament speakers, Budapest, Oct. 27, 2017); it reports only that he spoke and makes no claim about the content of his remarks, so no attribution is required and none is given.

bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.title: Typhoon Lan lashes central Japan, killing 2 and disrupting transport systems
bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.observation: A casualty figure is asserted in the outlet's own voice as settled fact: the excerpt states two people were killed and that transport and businesses were severely disrupted, without naming the police force, prefectural authority, disaster agency or wire service the death toll came from, in contrast to sibling items in this same feed that do name their source; the event is reported as completed, not forecast.

bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.title: Spotlight: U.S. decision to withdraw from UNESCO triggers calls for multilateralism
bf7b7201-c1cc-4e76-b850-c6f26375f31d.observation: The "Spotlight" prefix marks this as Xinhua's interpretive format rather than a straight news report, and the excerpt pairs a verifiable event (the U.S. decision to withdraw from UNESCO) with an aggregated reaction claim, that it "has triggered worldwide calls for supporting multilateralism," stated in the outlet's own voice without naming a single government, official or body making such a call.

b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.title: Palestinians clash with Israeli soldiers after protest against Pence visit
b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.observation: The excerpt is a photo caption, not reported text: it places the action ("Palestinian protesters hurl stones at Israeli soldiers") in Hebron on Jan. 23, 2018 in the agency's own voice, with no witness, official, police or military source named for the account of who clashed with whom.

b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.title: U.S. failure to appoint Australian ambassador "diplomatic insult": former deputy PM
b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.observation: Attribution is explicit and named in both the headline and the excerpt: the "diplomatic insult" characterisation is held inside quotation marks and assigned to former Australian Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer as his accusation rather than asserted as the agency's own conclusion; the excerpt does not say where or to whom he said it.

b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.title: Speaker of Hungarian Parliament addresses in Budapest
b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.observation: Another photo caption rather than an article: it identifies the subject by full name and office (Laszlo Kover, Speaker of the Hungarian Parliament) and fixes the occasion, city and date, but records only that he spoke, attributing no substance of his remarks to him.

b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.title: Typhoon Lan lashes central Japan, killing 2 and disrupting transport systems
b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.observation: Reports a completed event, not a forecast, but the casualty figure carries no attribution in the excerpt: "Two people were killed" is stated in the agency's own voice with no authority, police force or disaster agency credited, and the timing is given only as the relative "early Monday".

b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.title: Spotlight: U.S. decision to withdraw from UNESCO triggers calls for multilateralism
b5e30fa3-969f-44e9-9c21-e9a377ec2110.observation: A "Spotlight"-branded analysis item whose excerpt asserts an aggregate reaction as established fact, saying the withdrawal "has triggered worldwide calls for supporting multilateralism" without naming a single government, official or body that issued such a call.

76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.title: 中国第九批赴南苏丹（朱巴）维和步兵营完成指挥权交接
76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.observation: The command handover at the Chinese camp of the UN mission in Juba is asserted in the outlet's own voice as a completed event with no source named at all — no battalion officer, no Chinese defence ministry statement and no UNMISS spokesperson is quoted, and the claim that the eighth battalion "successfully completed" its year-long mandate is presented as established fact rather than attributed to the contingent making it.

76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.title: 习近平将向《生物多样性公约》第十五次缔约方大会第二阶段高级别会议开幕式致辞
76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.observation: This is the one item of the five with a named human source: the excerpt attributes the announcement to Foreign Ministry spokesperson Hua Chunying speaking on the 14th, and it is correctly framed as a scheduled future event (Xi will address the COP15 high-level opening by video on 15 December) rather than something that has occurred.

76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.title: 学习进行时｜二十大后重要外交活动，这些关键词习近平总书记反复提及
76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.observation: Sourcing cannot be assessed from this entry because the description field repeats the headline verbatim with no additional text; the 学习进行时 prefix marks it as an in-house standing column compiling Xi Jinping's phrasing rather than a reported news item, so what the feed offers is a house-branded commentary label and no attribution of any kind.

76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.title: 中国多家驻土机构参加土耳其创新周
76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.observation: Attendance is asserted without a single named participant: the excerpt places Turkey Innovation Week at the Haliç Congress Center in Istanbul on the 12th and 13th and says "several" (多家) Chinese institutions based in Turkey took part, but names none of them, quotes no organiser, and gives no figure behind the unquantified 多家.

76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.title: 匈牙利说就解冻恢复基金与欧盟达成协议
76a6a89d-f3ed-4c62-821b-6460e53c5611.observation: Attribution is carried in the headline itself — "Hungary says" — and the excerpt sources the claim to a named official, Regional Development and EU Funds Minister Navracsics, at a press conference on the 13th; the agreement to unfreeze several billion euros of EU recovery funds is therefore presented as one party's assertion, with no Commission confirmation or EU-side comment in the excerpt.

058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.title: Ukraine launches massive drone attack on Moscow as Russia votes in parliamentary elections
058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.observation: The excerpt asserts a causal chain — that the war contributes to a 'global energy crisis created by the US-Israel war on Iran' — in the publisher's own voice rather than attributing it to a named source.

058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.title: Iranian army says it received intel of imminent US attacks backed by regional states
058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.observation: Attributes both the intelligence claim and the retaliation threat to Tehran and the Iranian army; the headline's 'says' keeps the claim with its claimant rather than presenting it as established.

058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.title: Palestinian shoots illegal Jewish settler dead in West Bank, detained after hours-long manhunt
058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.observation: Reports a killing and an arrest as fact while the headline and excerpt apply the contested legal characterisation 'illegal' to the settler and to settlement generally, which is the publisher's editorial position stated as description.

058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.title: Sanaa targets 'sensitive sites' in Riyadh, Yanbu as Saudi warplanes bombard Yemen
058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.observation: Hedges the damage claim with 'reportedly' and puts 'sensitive sites' in quotation marks, but does not name the source of either the targeting claim or the Aramco tank report.

058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.title: Israeli army seals last road into West Bank village, trapping 47 Palestinian families
058df538-1df4-41b8-9039-93a479ad3332.observation: Attributes the stated purpose of the road closure to residents ('Residents say'), separating their account of intent from the physical closure the piece reports directly.
